newsitem.title: USA: Plane crashes in Michigan - report.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes in Michigan - report.

text.p: An airplane capable of carrying 35 to 40 people crashed about 10 miles west of here Thursday afternoon after taking off from Detroit Metropolitan Airport, WWJ-Radio reported.
There was no word on any injuries or where the plane was heading, the radio report said. Monroe is about 30 miles south of Detroit.
Southeastern Michigan, including Detroit, was blanketed under several inches of snow that started falling Thursday morning.
Local weather forecasters said visibility in the area of the crash was about three-quarters of a mile Thursday afternoon.
